findings.message: Text, a heading or an action covered by something painted over it at every scroll position where it is in view (rendered): <h2#ticket-title> “Install it: two commands in eith” under <svg.ticket__ring> at every stop where it is in view (first at 0 % down the page)
findings.fix: Move the covering layer (a picture, a filled panel, a drawn line, a cast shadow) off the text's box, or give the text a lane of its own; a layer that passes over text it leaves readable at another position (a curtain, clouds, a stacked panel) is not counted, nor is a small fixed header, a canvas (its pixels are judged from the frames) or a duplicate of the same text

findings.message: Outer margins differ left and right at desktop width (rendered): nearest text 8 px from the left edge and 60 px from the right
findings.fix: Set one pair of page margins and hang the navigation and every text block from them; keep asymmetry inside the grid, never in the frame
